[IUnknown_Release_Proxy is not supported and may be altered or unavailable in the future.] The NdrCStdStubBuffer_Release function implements the IRpcStubBuffer::Release method. ## -parameters ### -param This [in] Pointer to the IRpcStubBuffer object. ### -param pPSF [in] Pointer to the IPSFactoryBuffer object. The pointer is contained in the global variable, gPFactory, defined in RpcProxy.h. ## -returns Returns an integer from 1 to n, indicating the value of the new reference count. ## -remarks The return value is for diagnostic and testing purposes only; the return value may be unstable. This function is used internally by proxies that are generated by MIDL.
